## 3. IDEAL CLIENT DEFINITION (ICD)

A qualified DTM client must meet **ALL** baseline conditions.

### Mandatory Baselines:

* Revenue-generating business (or funded project)
* Decision-maker present on calls
* Willingness to share performance data
* Budget alignment with Tactical / Strategic / Sovereign tiers
* Openness to AI-driven execution (non-manual mindset)

### Automatic Disqualifiers:

* “Just testing agencies” mindset
* Price-first conversations
* No internal owner or champion
* Desire for isolated tactics without systems
* Refusal of data access or transparency
